get.description: `original` is only returned for assets marked as public and requires the account to have the `seoBaseUrl` setting configured.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: OAuth 2.0 Bearer access token.

parameters.name: brandId
parameters.description: Brand id, can be retrieved using the Retrieve brands and subbrands call.

parameters.name: subBrandId
parameters.description: Sub-brand id, can be retrieved using the Retrieve brands and subbrands call.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Category id, can be retrieved using the Retrieve categories call.

parameters.name: collectionId
parameters.description: Collection id, can be retrieved using the Retrieve collections call.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Asset id, will return the asset for that id.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of asset ids. Will return an asset for each existing id.

parameters.name: propertyOptionId
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of (metaproperty) option ids, can be retrieved using the Retrieve metaproperties call.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of tags, can be retrieved using the Retrieve tags call.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of asset types.

parameters.name: orientation
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of asset orientation.

parameters.name: property_NAME
parameters.description: Metaproperty option name or comma-separated list ids of metaproperty options for that metaproperty. Beware that NAME should be replaced with the actual metaproperty name. This is an AND operation when passing multiple values. If a Date type metaproperty is added, retrieving assets using the dates for that metaproperty is not supported.

parameters.name: limited
parameters.description: Indicates whether or not the response should only contain assets marked as "limited usage".

parameters.name: archive
parameters.description: Indicates whether or not the response should only contain archived assets.

parameters.name: isPublic
parameters.description: Indicates whether or not the response should only contain assets marked as public.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Search on filenames, tags, extensions, collection names, guidelines, brandstore, campaigns in workflow, enriched PDFs, word documents.

parameters.name: dateCreated
parameters.description: Retrieve assets created after this date.

parameters.name: dateCreatedTo
parameters.description: Set a date range together with the "dateCreated" parameter.

parameters.name: dateCreatedOn
parameters.description: Retrieve assets created on this specific date.

parameters.name: dateModified
parameters.description: Retrieve assets modified after this date.

parameters.name: dateModifiedTo
parameters.description: Set a date range together with the "dateModified" parameter.

parameters.name: dateModifiedOn
parameters.description: Retrieve assets modified on this specific date.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Order of the returned list of assets.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Offset page for results: return the N-th set of limit-results.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Indicating whether or not the response should include count results.

parameters.name: total
parameters.description: Indicating whether or not the response should include the total count of results.

parameters.name: includeMediaItems
parameters.description: Indicating whether or not the response should include all the different media items (derivatives) available for each asset.

parameters.name: includeVersionNumber
parameters.description: Indicating whether or not the response should include the active version number.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: cursorMark returned in the X-Bynder-NextCursor response header which allows to return the next set of results.

X-Bynder-NextCursor.description: SOLR nextCursorMark which can be used to return the next X number of results. Returned when solr-cursor account feature is enabled.

get.description: Requires the **STATISTICS** security role in order to retrieve *views* and *downloads* statistics data in the response, using the `stats` parameter.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: OAuth 2.0 Bearer access token.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Asset id.

parameters.name: versions
parameters.description: Include information about the different asset media items including versions.

parameters.name: stats
parameters.description: Include information about *views* and *downloads*.

post.description: Requires the **MEDIAEDIT** security role. Requires the **MARKPUBLIC** security role in order to change an asset's isPublic state.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Asset id.

name.description: Name of the asset, beware the asset will have no name when this is empty.

brandId.description: Id of the brand to save the asset to.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags. Tags will overwrite the current tags list.

metaproperty.description: Dictionary with (metaproperty) options to set on the asset.

archive.description: Indicating the archived state of the asset.

limited.description: Indicating the limit state of the asset.

isPublic.description: Indicating the public state of the asset. Warning irreversible, once changed to true it cannot be changed back.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: OAuth 2.0 Bearer access token.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Asset id.

post.description: These calls allow you to change the metaproperty options attached to an asset.
